6 تسامع بِهِ النَّاسُ (S, K) The people heard of it, [or him,] one from another: (PS, TK:) [or the people heard one another talk of it, or him:] or it, or he, became notorious among the people. (TA.) ―
-b2- تسامع also signifies He feigned himself hearing. (KL.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
